label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Applying entity and validity-date filtering will remove cross-entity and temporally invalid candidates before ranking, fixing the demonstrated retrieval failures; deduplication is deferred because the primary errors are filtering errors and only two settings may change.
predicted_effect: Increase complete-scenario success by selecting the requested entity and records valid at the requested as-of date, while preserving owner isolation and write behavior. The change may also reduce distracting retrieval, but it is not expected to fix low-confidence admission.
